name: Dog Sodomite
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of dogs in various ways to convey spiritual truths and warnings. Dogs are depicted as unclean and contemptible, with their 'price' being forbidden in the sanctuary as an abomination (Deuteronomy 23:18), and as dumb, blind watchmen who fail in their duties (Isaiah 56:10). Their behaviors, such as lapping water (Judges 7:5), licking blood and sores, and returning to their own vomit (Proverbs 26:11), illustrate folly and moral degradation. Additionally, the term 'dog' serves as a figurative epithet of contempt, underscoring the contrast between godly conduct and those who persist in sin.
